decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper extends the firm's core range and was launched with its own web page only a year ago, so the investment and public commitment favor keeping it while early results mature.
The articulated dumper builds on established engineering and dealer channels, and its visible launch fits the announced direction of refining the range, so management will persist with it.

Although the mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer, the substantial development effort and public presentation make management inclined to treat slow niche sales as temporary and keep it for at least another year.
The compact telescopic loader complements the firm's lifting and construction portfolio, and its recent dedicated launch creates strong commitment to continue.
